note: Hand-authored seed list for the Old-World rescope (board item #2207). Land the user did NOT draw into sources/old_world_regions.png collapses to one impassable placeholder cell per out-of-scope MAJOR continent; this file names those continents and seeds them. generate_state_labels.py labels the connected components of (land AND NOT in_scope): each seed CLAIMS the component it lands in (any size, any adjacency), a component claimed by two or more seeds is split geodesically between them (Naggaroth + Lustria are one physical landmass; the southlands + eastern lands are one component until the in-scope mask severs them), small unclaimed components fold into the nearest placeholder, and any unclaimed component at or above OOS_MAJOR_MIN (50,000 px) is a HARD error naming its area + centroid. A seed on water or on in-scope land is likewise a hard error. Like mapgen/config/inland_lakes.json this is deliberate geographic input, edited by hand and regenerated through, NEVER inferred from a regenerated bitmap. Order is authored order and is the placeholder cells' numbering/presentation order (do not sort). Seeds are guaranteed-interior land pixels in provinces.png canvas space (x, y), 8192x3616. PROVISIONAL 2026-08-20: seeds verified interior-land on the committed land_sea_mask.png but NOT yet against the drawn in-scope mask (that needs sources/old_world_regions.png manifest-pinned); canon names + any additions the >=50k audit forces are the user's call at the render.

continents.name: naggaroth
continents.note: Naggaroth — northern New World. Shares one physical landmass with Lustria (~2.73M px combined); the two seeds split it geodesically.

continents.name: lustria
continents.note: Lustria — southern New World; same landmass as Naggaroth.

continents.name: ulthuan
continents.note: Ulthuan — the high elf isle (~130k px), its own component.

continents.name: western_ocean_mass
continents.note: ~118k px mid-ocean landmass west of the Old World (bbox x[2546,3012] y[1058,1601]); above the audit floor so it must be seeded. Canon identity TBD — flag at render. Evidence 2026-10-05: on the committed land_sea_mask this component (118,436 px, same bbox) is the Ulthuan ring isle as drawn on terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, while the seed named `ulthuan` above lands on water (the Maelstrom archipelago edge); the two names look swapped. Not changed here: the seeds feed generate_state_labels, so re-seed at a render.

continents.name: southlands
continents.note: The Southlands south of Nehekhara. Connected to the main Old-World continent until the drawn in-scope mask subtracts; may arrive as one component with eastern_lands and split geodesically.

continents.name: eastern_lands
continents.note: The far east (Cathay / Ind / Eastern Steppes) — all deferred out of scope this phase; one placeholder for the whole eastern remainder.

continents.name: nippon
continents.note: ~111k px far-eastern island group (Nippon-like); above the audit floor. Canon identity TBD — flag at render. Evidence 2026-10-05: ChaosRobie's expanded map draws this island group as Nippon (provinces Aotsukishu, Taigenshu, Koteishu, Shotaku Marshes, Goshinmori, Isle of Heaven, Koyashu Isles; his loc `nippon_*`), east of Khuresh across the Sea of Nippon.

continents.name: far_south_east
continents.note: ~128k px far south-eastern mass; above the audit floor. Canon identity TBD — flag at render. Evidence 2026-10-05: on the globe it sits just south of the Gates of Calith; ChaosRobie's expanded map draws that southern landmass as Craving Peninsula with Fiend Coast and, west of it, Shattered Barrens (loc `fiend_peninsula`, `fiend_coast`).
